summary.text: Elaine Bowers is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 36 (Cloud County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2013.
Elaine Bowers is listed as chair of the Local Government, Transparency and Ethics Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Elaine Bowers served in the House (2007–2012) before the current service in the Senate that began in 2013.
Elaine Bowers is listed as a member of the Local Government, Transparency and Ethics Committee, the Judiciary Committee, the Transportation Committee and the Utilities Committee.
The Legislature lists Elaine Bowers's occupation as Auto Dealer.
The page names Charlie Bowers as Elaine Bowers's spouse.
